title: Build CLI Tools with Python
goal: Learn Python fundamentals and build a portfolio project to become job-ready for a Junior Python Developer role.

phases.title: Setup Development Environment
phases.goal: Install and configure necessary tools and set up a development environment.

phases.title: Learn Python Basics
phases.goal: Understand Python syntax, data types, and basic control structures.

phases.title: Build Simple CLI Tools
phases.goal: Create command-line tools to practice Python basics.

phases.title: Learn Object-Oriented Programming
phases.goal: Understand OOP concepts and how to apply them in Python.

phases.title: Develop a Portfolio Project
phases.goal: Build a more complex CLI tool as a portfolio project.

phases.title: Learn Career Preparation
phases.goal: Prepare for job applications, interviews, and CV optimization.

tasks.title: Install Python and IDE
tasks.why: VS Code is a popular IDE for Python development and has excellent support.
steps: Install Python from https://www.python.org/downloads/
Install Visual Studio Code from https://code.visualstudio.com/
Install the Python extension for VS Code
tasks.doneWhen: Python and VS Code are installed, and the Python extension is active.
tasks.check: Create a new Python file and run a simple print statement.

tasks.title: Install Command Line Tools
tasks.why: Terminal tools are essential for development and testing.
steps: Install Git from https://git-scm.com/downloads
Install Poetry from https://python-poetry.org/docs/
tasks.check: Test installing a package with Poetry.

tasks.title: Learn Python Syntax
tasks.why: Syntax is the foundation of any programming language.
steps: Read the Python documentation on syntax at https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/index.html
Write and run a simple Python script with print statements.
tasks.doneWhen: A simple Python script is written and runs.
tasks.check: A test script is written and runs without errors.

tasks.title: Data Types and Variables
tasks.why: Understanding data types and variables is crucial for any Python project.
steps: Read about data types and variables in the Python documentation at https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/datastructures.html
Practice declaring and using variables and different data types.
tasks.doneWhen: Variables and data types are declared and used in a script.
tasks.check: A script demonstrating variable and data type usage runs without errors.

tasks.title: Control Structures
tasks.why: Control structures are essential for logic and flow in programs.
steps: Read about control structures in the Python documentation at https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/controlflow.html
Practice writing and running simple control structures such as if-else and loops.
tasks.doneWhen: Control structures are implemented in a script.
tasks.check: A script with control structures runs as expected.

tasks.title: Build a Simple CLI Tool: Greeting
tasks.why: Practicing with a simple tool helps build confidence.
steps: Create a new Python file and write a script that prints 'Hello, World!' to the terminal.
Test the script in the terminal.
tasks.check: The script prints 'Hello, World!' to the terminal.

tasks.title: Build a Simple CLI Tool: Calculator
tasks.why: Building a calculator reinforces basic operations and user input handling.
steps: Create a new Python file and write a script that performs basic math operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division).
Test the script in the terminal with various inputs.
tasks.doneWhen: A calculator script runs successfully with various inputs.
tasks.check: The calculator script works for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

tasks.title: Learn Object-Oriented Programming
tasks.why: OOP is a fundamental concept in Python and most development.
steps: Read about OOP in the Python documentation at https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/classes.html
Write a simple class with attributes and methods.
tasks.doneWhen: A simple class is implemented with attributes and methods.
tasks.check: A class is created and can be instantiated and used.

tasks.title: Build a CLI Tool: Simple Database
tasks.why: Combining OOP with CLI tools can demonstrate practical application.
steps: Create a class for a simple database with methods to add, delete, and search for entries.
Build a CLI tool that uses this database class.
tasks.doneWhen: A simple database tool with OOP is built and runs.
tasks.check: The CLI tool can add, delete, and search for entries in the database.

tasks.title: Develop a Portfolio Project: File Manager
tasks.why: A portfolio project showcases practical skills and application.
steps: Design a file manager CLI tool with features like listing files, creating directories, and copying files.
Implement the design in Python.
Test the tool thoroughly.
tasks.doneWhen: A file manager CLI tool is built and functions correctly.
tasks.check: The file manager can list, create, and copy files and directories.

tasks.title: Prepare CV and Portfolio
tasks.why: Tailoring a CV and portfolio to the target role is crucial.
steps: Create a resume highlighting skills learned and the portfolio project.
Publish the portfolio project on GitHub.
tasks.doneWhen: A resume and GitHub portfolio are prepared and published.
tasks.check: The portfolio project is live on GitHub and referenced in the resume.

tasks.title: Practice Live Coding
tasks.why: Live coding is often used in interviews to assess real-time problem-solving.
steps: Practice solving coding problems in a live coding environment like LeetCode or HackerRank.
Record a live coding session demonstrating problem-solving skills.
tasks.doneWhen: Coding problems are solved in a live coding environment and a recording is made.
tasks.check: At least 5 problems are solved and a live coding session is recorded.

tasks.title: Practice System Design
tasks.why: System design questions are common in technical interviews.
steps: Read and practice system design problems and solutions.
Create a system design document for a small application.
tasks.doneWhen: A system design document is created and shared.
tasks.check: A system design document for a CLI tool is completed.

tasks.title: Practice Take-Home Coding
tasks.why: Take-home coding challenges assess the candidate's ability to work independently.
steps: Solve a take-home coding challenge from a past interview question.
Submit the solution with a brief explanation.
tasks.doneWhen: A take-home coding challenge is solved and submitted.
tasks.check: A solution is submitted for a take-home coding challenge.

tasks.title: Apply for Jobs
tasks.why: Finding the right opportunities is key.
steps: Search for Junior Python Developer roles on popular job boards.
Apply to selected positions with the resume and portfolio.
tasks.check: Applications are submitted to at least 3 Junior Python Developer roles.
